description: M4 held-out functions for model/template candidate evaluation. Written for this evaluation (origin: InvariantGuard repository, same license as the repository); not used in the prompt (the prompt example is halve_all) or in any test fixture. Seeded bugs contradict the function's own docstring; reference implementations live in benchmarks/m4_reference.py, which no discovery source sees.

seeded_bug.class: wrong constant: divides by sum + 1e-3, so the result does not sum to 1

seeded_bug.note: Corrected after the 2026-10-08 run (it was annotated false before running): DSL v1 has no counting operator, but a precondition-restricted claim such as all_between(xs, -1e6, 0) => result == 0 expresses the bug; the model proposed exactly that in repeat 1. The results file header (seeded_bugs_dsl_expressible = 4) reflects the pre-run annotation.

seeded_bug.class: mutation: sorts the caller's list in place although documented as not modifying it
missing lower clamp: negative inputs are returned unchanged
